name: Climbing rope
description: Six metres of hemp with a grapple knot at one end. Tie it off up high and everyone after you has a way up.
notes: A placeable rope (mw-e10.9): Interact at a level's rope anchor ties it (spends one), Interact on the tied rope unties it and gives it back. It hangs 6 m from the anchor and climbs like any rope (ladder-easy, quiet); creatures that climb get an off-mesh link up it while it hangs. Not equippable. Placeholder icon shared with the rope arrow until its own is made.
